module_summary: 8-to-16 bit width converter: buffers odd/even bytes and outputs combined 16-bit result when second byte arrives.

anchors.name: phz
anchors.why: Phase toggle distinguishing odd/even input bytes for buffering.

anchors.name: hi_q
anchors.why: Latches high byte when odd input arrives.

anchors.name: hit
anchors.why: Completion trigger when second byte (even) received.

anchors.name: pk
anchors.why: Packs high byte and current input into 16-bit output.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: Output valid pulse when second byte received.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input byte valid pulse triggering phase toggle.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: Input byte stream packed into 16-bit words.

anchors.name: arm_n
anchors.why: Inverted arm signal: disables high-byte capture when phz or not valid.

anchors.name: hi_q_dup
anchors.why: Duplicate high byte register for redundancy.

groups.name: Phase Control
groups.description: Phase toggle managing odd/even byte sequencing.

groups.name: Storage
groups.description: High byte latch and duplicate for buffer control.

groups.name: Datapath
groups.description: Combines high and low bytes into packed 16-bit result.

groups.name: Control & Status
groups.description: Hit completion flag and output valid handshake.
